steps.name: Environment setup and optional global persistence
steps.description: Create workspace directory, validate Node and package manager, compute and validate npm global bin, optionally persist PATH in /etc/profile.d, and write a project-scoped .env.development when global NODE_ENV is not opted-in. Writing NODE_ENV to /etc/profile.d is only performed when ENV_PERSIST_GLOBAL=1 is set to avoid impacting other services. After modifying /etc/profile.d the script sources it into the current session so subsequent steps see the PATH changes immediately.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/stock-insights-analyzer-234320-237759/stock_analyzer_frontend"
sudo mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE" && sudo chown "$(id -u):$(id -g)" "$WORKSPACE"
# validate node and pm
if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "node not found" >&2; exit 2; fi
NODE_V_RAW=$(node -v || true)
NODE_V=${NODE_V_RAW#v}
NODE_MAJOR=$(node -p "parseInt(process.versions.node.split('.')[0],10)")
if [ "$NODE_MAJOR" -lt 18 ]; then echo "node version $NODE_V_RAW unsupported; require >=18.x" >&2; exit 3; fi
PM="npm"
if command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -z "${PREFER_NPM:-}" ]; then PM="yarn"; elif command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then PM="npm"; fi
# detect npm global bin and validate
NPM_G_BIN="/usr/local/bin"
if [ "$PM" = "npm" ] && command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then NPM_G_BIN=$(npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || echo "/usr/local/bin"); fi
if [ ! -d "$NPM_G_BIN" ] || [ ! -x "$NPM_G_BIN" ]; then NPM_G_BIN="/usr/local/bin"; fi
# write project-scoped env by default; global persistence only if ENV_PERSIST_GLOBAL=1
ENV_PROJ="$WORKSPACE/.env.development"
cat > "$ENV_PROJ" <<EOF
NODE_ENV=development
PORT=3000
EOF
# optionally write PATH to /etc/profile.d and NODE_ENV globally if opted-in
if [ "${ENV_PERSIST_GLOBAL:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  ENV_FILE=/etc/profile.d/stock_frontend_env.sh
  NEW_CONTENT="# stock_analyzer_frontend environment (added by setup)
export PATH=\"$NPM_G_BIN:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin\"
export NODE_ENV=development
export PORT=3000
"
  TMP=$(mktemp)
  echo "$NEW_CONTENT" >"$TMP"
  if ! sudo test -f "$ENV_FILE" || ! sudo cmp -s "$TMP" "$ENV_FILE"; then sudo cp "$TMP" "$ENV_FILE" && sudo chmod 644 "$ENV_FILE"; fi
  rm -f "$TMP"
  # make effective for current session
  # shellcheck disable=SC1091
  source /etc/profile.d/stock_frontend_env.sh || true
fi
# export project PATH for current run so installed local bins are preferred
export PATH="$NPM_G_BIN:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:$PATH"
# record PM choice
echo "PM=$PM" > "$WORKSPACE/.pm"
# log versions
echo "node=$NODE_V_RAW" "pm=$PM" "npm=$(npm -v 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)" "yarn=$(yarn -v 2>/dev/null || echo none)"

steps.name: Install dependencies (lockfile-aware, respects PM)
steps.description: Install project dependencies deterministically using the workspace-preferred package manager. If yarn.lock exists and PM=yarn use 'yarn install --frozen-lockfile'; if package-lock.json exists and PM=npm use 'npm ci'. Otherwise install dependencies declared in package.json using the selected PM (npm i or yarn install). Dev dependencies are installed via the selected PM to avoid mixing. After install, log versions of node, npm/yarn, vite, and jest. Ensure PATH from s1 is exported into the current session so that local binaries are preferred.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/stock-insights-analyzer-234320-237759/stock_analyzer_frontend"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# load recorded PM and ensure PATH from environment step
PM="npm"
if [ -f "$WORKSPACE/.pm" ]; then PM=$(cut -d= -f2 "$WORKSPACE/.pm" 2>/dev/null || echo npm); fi
export PATH="/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:$PATH"
# prefer using persisted profile if present
if [ -f /etc/profile.d/stock_frontend_env.sh ] && [ "${ENV_PERSIST_GLOBAL:-0}" = "1" ]; then # shellcheck disable=SC1091
  source /etc/profile.d/stock_frontend_env.sh || true
fi
# lockfile-aware
if [ "$PM" = "yarn" ]; then
  if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn install --frozen-lockfile --silent; else yarn install --silent; fi
else
  if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --silent; else npm i --no-audit --no-fund --silent; fi
fi
# verify local binaries available (prefer local node_modules/.bin)
VITE_BIN="$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/vite"
JEST_BIN="$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/jest"
SERVE_BIN="$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/serve"
if [ ! -x "$VITE_BIN" ] && ! command -v vite >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "vite not available after install" >&2; exit 7; fi
if [ ! -x "$JEST_BIN" ] && ! command -v jest >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "jest not available after install" >&2; exit 8; fi
# log versions for troubleshooting
echo "node: $(node -v)"
if [ "$PM" = "yarn" ]; then echo "yarn: $(yarn -v)"; else echo "npm: $(npm -v)"; fi
( command -v vite >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "vite: $(vite --version 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)" ) || true
( command -v jest >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "jest: $(jest --version 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)" ) || true

steps.description: Create jest and babel config files only if missing, add a minimal React Testing Library smoke test if absent, install testing devDeps via the selected package manager if necessary, and run tests using the local jest binary. This step preserves existing configs and avoids overwriting user files.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/stock-insights-analyzer-234320-237759/stock_analyzer_frontend"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
[ -f package.json ] || { echo "package.json missing; run scaffold first" >&2; exit 6; }
# write jest config only if missing
if [ ! -f "$WORKSPACE/jest.config.cjs" ]; then cat > "$WORKSPACE/jest.config.cjs" <<'JCFG'
module.exports = { testEnvironment: 'jsdom', transform: { '^.+\\.jsx?$': ['babel-jest', { presets: ['@babel/preset-env','@babel/preset-react'] }] } }
JCFG
fi
# write babel rc only if missing
if [ ! -f "$WORKSPACE/.babelrc" ]; then cat > "$WORKSPACE/.babelrc" <<'BRC'
{ "presets": ["@babel/preset-env","@babel/preset-react"] }
BRC
fi
# add minimal test if missing
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/src/__tests__"
if [ ! -f "$WORKSPACE/src/__tests__/App.test.jsx" ]; then cat > "$WORKSPACE/src/__tests__/App.test.jsx" <<'TST'
import React from 'react'
import { render } from '@testing-library/react'
import '@testing-library/jest-dom'
function App(){ return React.createElement('div', null, 'Stock Analyzer UI') }
test('renders text', () => {
  const { getByText } = render(React.createElement(App))
  expect(getByText('Stock Analyzer UI')).toBeInTheDocument()
})
TST
fi
# run local jest if present
JEST_BIN="$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/jest"
if [ -x "$JEST_BIN" ]; then "$JEST_BIN" --config=jest.config.cjs --runInBand; else if command -v jest >/dev/null 2>&1; then jest --config=jest.config.cjs --runInBand; else echo "jest binary not found" >&2; exit 7; fi; fi

steps.name: Build, start, smoke-test and clean shutdown
steps.description: Build the Vite app using local or global vite, serve the built dist binding to 0.0.0.0 with a fallback port option, perform HTTP smoke test against localhost:$PORT, and ensure clean shutdown of the full process group. Checks for curl availability and prints logs on failure. Sources project .env.development for PORT unless global persistence was explicitly enabled.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/stock-insights-analyzer-234320-237759/stock_analyzer_frontend"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# source project env first
if [ -f "$WORKSPACE/.env.development" ]; then set -a; source "$WORKSPACE/.env.development"; set +a; fi
# fallback to global profile only if explicitly persisted
if [ "${ENV_PERSIST_GLOBAL:-0}" = "1" ] && [ -f /etc/profile.d/stock_frontend_env.sh ]; then # shellcheck disable=SC1091
  source /etc/profile.d/stock_frontend_env.sh || true
fi
PORT=${PORT:-3000}
TMP_LOG=/tmp/stock_frontend_serve.log
TMP_HTML=/tmp/stock_frontend_smoke.html
cleanup() {
  if [ -n "${SERVE_PGID:-}" ]; then kill -TERM -"${SERVE_PGID}" 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 1; kill -KILL -"${SERVE_PGID}" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
  rm -f "$TMP_LOG" "$TMP_HTML" || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT
# find vite
VITE_BIN="$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/vite"
if [ ! -x "$VITE_BIN" ]; then if command -v vite >/dev/null 2>&1; then VITE_BIN=$(command -v vite); else echo "vite not found" >&2; exit 8; fi; fi
# build
"$VITE_BIN" build || (echo "vite build failed" >&2; exit 9)
# find serve
SERVE_BIN="$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/serve"
if [ ! -x "$SERVE_BIN" ]; then if command -v serve >/dev/null 2>&1; then SERVE_BIN=$(command -v serve); fi; fi
# start server: prefer serve, fallback to simple node static server if necessary
if [ -n "${SERVE_BIN:-}" ]; then
  # try tcp form then fallback to plain -l
  set -m
  ( setsid "$SERVE_BIN" -s dist -l "tcp://0.0.0.0:$PORT" >"$TMP_LOG" 2>&1 ) &
  sleep 0.2
  if ! grep -q "" "$TMP_LOG" 2>/dev/null; then true; fi
  # capture PGID to kill whole group
  SERVE_PGID=$(ps -o pgid= -p $! | tr -d ' ')
else
  # fallback: use a tiny node static server (no extra deps)
  node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const dir='dist';const server=http.createServer((req,res)=>{let f=p.join(dir,req.url==='/'?'/index.html':req.url);fs.readFile(f,(e,d)=>{if(e){res.statusCode=404;res.end('not found');return}res.end(d)})}).listen($PORT, '0.0.0.0');" >"$TMP_LOG" 2>&1 &
  SERVE_PGID=$(ps -o pgid= -p $! | tr -d ' ')
fi
# wait for readiness
if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "curl required for validation but not found" >&2; exit 10; fi
MAX=60
i=0
until curl -sSf "http://localhost:$PORT/" >"$TMP_HTML" 2>/dev/null || [ $i -ge $MAX ]; do sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done
if [ $i -ge $MAX ]; then echo "server did not become ready in ${MAX}s" >&2; echo "--- serve log (tail) ---" >&2; tail -n 200 "$TMP_LOG" >&2; exit 11; fi
head -n 40 "$TMP_HTML" || true
echo "validation completed"
# cleanup via trap
